notes: RISK has no constructor arguments. RISKHook constructor arguments, in declaration order, are IPoolManager manager ($poolManager) and address launchToken ($token). The deployer resolves these to Ethereum mainnet's Uniswap v4 PoolManager and the newly deployed RISK. RISKHook is deployed directly using CREATE2 with its lower 14 address bits equal to 0x20c4: beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap and afterSwapReturnDelta; all other permissions are false. Callbacks accept only the PoolManager. beforeInitialize accepts only this hook's RISK/IMD pool with static LP fee 12500 (1.25%) and tick spacing 60. The listed initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 for provenance; the launch factory derives the opening price from launch economics. Every external swap pays an additional 1% of the absolute actual BalanceDelta on the unspecified currency, rounded down, through afterSwapReturnDelta. Exact-input swaps pay in the output currency; exact-output swaps pay in the input currency. Fees accrue as PoolManager ERC-6909 claims, with no specified-side reservation, dynamic LP fee or LP fee override. Anyone can call sweep() to redeem RISK claims to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Anyone can call executeBatch() in a separate transaction at least 3600 seconds after initialization or the last successful batch. It swaps exact-input IMD through PoolManager.unlock and swap, budgeting at most 25% of pending IMD claims, capped at int128 maximum. Its sqrtPriceLimit enforces a 300 bps price band from the hook's geometric time-weighted reference, tightened against pre-batch spot. Partial or zero fills retain unspent claims for later batches; there is no minimum-output check. Hook-originated batch swaps pay no hook fee, and bought RISK goes to the same burn address. Parameters are fixed; there is no owner, setter, proxy or upgrade path. Views pending(), pendingBurn(), lastBatch() and referencePrice() expose accrued IMD claims, accrued RISK claims, the batch timestamp and the reference sqrtPriceX96.
